title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: MCP security hardens fleet-wide — NSA publishes official MCP hardening guidance the same month a critical auto-execution flaw hits Amazon Q
bullets.summary: July's MCP security cycle produced formal NSA hardening guidelines alongside disclosure of critical auto-execution / prompt-injection vulnerabilities in agent tooling (Amazon Q among them) — the ecosystem now treats MCP servers as a governed attack surface, not free plumbing.
bullets.how: The Construct runs its own MCP fleet; pair the security review with the mandatory Jul-28 migration inventory so one /doctor pass yields the unused-server list AND a hardening checklist (auth, no auto-exec, provenance) before we expose any internal server more widely.

bullets.title: Revid.ai ships a video-production MCP — render, voiceover, caption, schedule, and publish are now agent-callable tools
bullets.summary: Launched Jul 16 (slightly off the 24h window but not previously flagged as a bullet); the server exposes stable tools — render_video, clone_voice, schedule_publish, publish_now, export_video, get_project_status — across nine production workflows (script-to-video, prompt-to-video, audio-to-video).
bullets.how: Directly maps to Brand 9 Signs signage/social video and PRAGMA's operator wedge: one Construct content-ops agent that scripts, renders, captions, schedules, and publishes with no editor in the loop. Evaluate against Higgsfield (already connected) on cost/quality per finished clip.

bullets.title: MCP spec 2026-07-28 is now 7 days out — stateless core plus MCP Apps (server-rendered UI) and Tasks as first-class extensions
bullets.summary: The breaking stateless rewrite (no handshake / session id, any request to any instance, OAuth-aligned auth, formal deprecation policy) lands final on Jul 28, with MCP Apps letting a tool return a sandboxed-iframe UI and the Tasks extension modeling long-running jobs via tasks/get, tasks/update, tasks/cancel.
bullets.how: Every MCP server The Construct runs is 7 days from a breaking change; Tasks maps onto our long-running scan jobs and MCP Apps could render a server's own dashboard tile. Finish the migration inventory this week.

bullets.title: arXiv — 'Context Engineering: From Prompts to Corporate Multi-Agent Architecture' gives the fleet a governance vocabulary
bullets.summary: Proposes five context-quality criteria (relevance, sufficiency, isolation, economy, provenance), frames context as the agent's operating system, and adds intent engineering (encode org goals) plus specification engineering (machine-readable corporate policy) to run multi-agent systems at scale.
bullets.how: A clean rubric to grade what we load into each Construct agent's context and a frame for turning CLAUDE.md-style memory into governed, machine-readable policy; adopt the five criteria as a review checklist, don't re-architect today.

praxis_lesson: The MCP layer is maturing on three fronts at once — security (NSA hardening + live CVEs), protocol (the Jul-28 stateless rewrite with Apps + Tasks), and governance vocabulary (context-engineering rubrics) — so the load-bearing Construct move this week is a single /doctor pass that produces the unused-server list, the Jul-28 migration inventory, AND a hardening checklist. The concrete Brand 9 Signs application on top of that governed fleet is a domain MCP like Revid.ai's video server: own the content-ops orchestration, keep the plumbing secure and migrated.
